# The Snail King

*A giant snail named Mano sleeps in a hollow past the woods, and it does not like visitors. Watch the red marks: they show where it will land. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [Mano](../monsters/mano.md) |
| Arena | [The Snail King's Hollow](../maps/snail_kings_hollow.md) |

- Unlocked by [The Snail King](../quests/the_snail_king.md)
- Entered by talking to [Hale](../npcs/hale.md)
